brief:
Israeli forces conducted raids across the occupied West Bank and detained several Palestinians, including individuals who had been recently released, the Palestinian news agency Wafa reported. The operations targeted homes in multiple locations throughout the territory.

The detentions mark a pattern of arrests affecting Palestinians who had previously been held in Israeli custody, according to Wafa's account of the raids.
dek: Israeli forces detain recently released prisoners in West Bank raids Israeli forces have raided homes and arrested several Palestinians, including recently released prisoners, across the occupied West Bank, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa.
title: Israeli forces arrest recently freed Palestinians in West Bank raids
